name: auto-poke-rng
description: A desktop workspace for Pokémon RNG automation tools.

scripts.setup:runtime: npm run build:runtime && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/setup-script-host.ps1
scripts.test:devices: npm run build && node tests/run-electron.cjs electron-devices.cjs
scripts.test:controller-mock: npm run build && node tests/run-electron.cjs controller-mock.cjs
scripts.test:controller-overlay: npm run build && node tests/run-electron.cjs controller-overlay.cjs
scripts.test:mapping: npm run build && node tests/run-electron.cjs key-mapping.cjs
scripts.test:script-editor: npm run build && node tests/run-electron.cjs script-editor.cjs
